cards.name: Color Emboss
cards.summary: Embosses the edges of the image like a raised metal or paper relief while keeping the original colours. A stylised texture effect, not a correction.
use_for: stylised still/photo treatment for a flashback or 'archive' montage beat
textured background plate behind titles in an explainer (with Blend With Original)
one-frame graphic hit on a beat in a social reel
avoid: faces in documentaries: high Relief makes skin look crusty and cheap
using it as a sharpen substitute; it adds halos, use Unsharp Mask instead

params.name: Direction
params.does: light direction of the relief, degrees

params.name: Relief
params.does: apparent height / edge thickness in pixels

params.name: Blend With Original
params.does: percent of the untouched image mixed back in
params.typical: 0 for full look, 40-70 for a subtle texture

cards.scripting: Direction is an angle in degrees (UI shows 0x+45.0). Relief harvested range 0..1000 but useful 1-10; Contrast 0..32767 but useful 50-500. Blend With Original is 0..100 percent.

verified.note: Strong raised-relief emboss on every edge (faces, stripes, foreground blocks, wall mouldings) while the original warm colours are kept.

cards.name: Color Balance (HLS)
cards.summary: Shifts the hue of the whole image and adjusts overall lightness and saturation (Hue / Lightness / Saturation). A quick global colour twist or desaturation.
use_for: desaturate to black-and-white (Saturation -100) for flashback / archive sections of a documentary
animated saturation drain on a 'dark turn' beat in a political explainer
surreal hue shift for a dream or glitch beat in a reel
quick saturation boost on dull phone footage
avoid: large Hue shifts on people: skin turns green/blue
Lightness: it flattens contrast and lifts blacks; use Lumetri Exposure instead
cards.equivalent: Color Balance (HLS) (AE has the same effect); Hue/Saturation is the fuller AE tool
cards.scripting: Hue is an angle in degrees (harvested range is the raw angle limit, use -180..180). Lightness and Saturation are clamped -100..100. Folder may be Color Correction or Obsolete depending on build; apply by name either way. Lumetri Color is the modern choice for real grading.

verified.note: Hue +90 turned the whole image into a saturated green wash (beige wall, skin and red stripes all green), a clear global hue twist.

cards.name: Color Key
cards.summary: Makes every pixel close to one chosen colour transparent, with tolerance, edge thin and edge feather controls. A simple hard-edged key for flat-colour backgrounds.
use_for: drop the flat white/black background of a logo or graphic so it sits over B-roll
remove a solid-colour background from a screen recording or chart export
stylised colour cut-out where footage on the track below shows through
avoid: real green/blue screen footage with uneven light or hair: use Ultra Key
high Color Tolerance on live action: keys skin, suits and shadows too

params.name: Key Color
params.typical: the background colour, e.g. #00B140 for green, #FFFFFF for white

params.name: Color Tolerance
params.does: how far from the key colour is still removed, 0..255

params.name: Edge Thin
params.does: chokes (+) or spreads (-) the matte edge, pixels

cards.equivalent: Color Key (AE files the same effect under Obsolete); Keylight (1.2) or Linear Color Key for real screens
cards.scripting: Keyed areas become transparent: with nothing on the track below they render as the black sequence background. Put the keyed clip on a higher track than the fill. Tolerance is on a 0..255 scale (not percent); the harvested default Key Color is pure blue. The demo keys the beige wall (#B99A64) of the PVE test clip so holes clearly appear; a white key barely touches that footage. Still listed under Keying in Premiere (only AE moved it to Obsolete).

verified.note: Every beige wall and skin-toned area near #B99A64 was keyed to transparency (black), leaving ragged hard-edged holes around the figures and stripes.

cards.name: 4-Color Gradient
cards.summary: Generates a smooth four-colour gradient from four placeable colour points and blends it over the clip (or replaces it at full opacity).
use_for: animated colourful backdrop for title cards / lower-third panels (applied to a colour matte)
brand-colour wash over B-roll behind explainer text: gradient on a colour matte on the track above, matte Opacity 20-40% or its Opacity blend mode set to Overlay / Soft Light
moody colour grade wash on trailer shots (same matte-above route)
background for quote cards in social reels
avoid: applying it straight to footage at default settings: Blending Mode 0 (believed None) replaces the picture completely
low Blend with saturated colours: visible banding and hard seams

params.name: Opacity
params.does: strength of the gradient, percent (with Blending Mode 0 the clip is believed not to show through, so lower it only with another mode)

params.name: Blending Mode
params.does: how the gradient combines with the clip (22-item dropdown 0..21; 0 = default, believed None = gradient only)
params.typical: 0 on a matte; 1 (believed Normal) to lay it over the clip

cards.scripting: Ignore the bool rows 'Positions & Colors' and 'Color 4#2' (group markers, not settable). Points are [x, y] frame fractions; Color 1..4 are #RRGGBB (defaults yellow, cyan, magenta, blue). Blending Mode is a 0-based 22-item dropdown; labels are NOT verified. The AE harvest of the same effect (1-based) is believed to start None, Normal, Add, Multiply, Screen, Overlay, Soft Light ... so 0 = None (gradient replaces the clip, Opacity fades it toward transparency/black) and 1 = Normal (gradient over the clip at Opacity). The demo uses 1 at Opacity 60 so the footage stays visible under the wash. The reliable route for a wash over footage is a colour matte with this effect on the track above, blended with the matte clip's own Opacity / Blend Mode.

verified.note: A yellow/cyan/pink/blue four-corner gradient is blended at 60% over the shot, tinting each corner a different colour while the image stays readable.

cards.name: Corner Pin
cards.summary: Moves the four corners of the clip independently, distorting it into any quadrilateral for perspective placement.
use_for: place a screenshot, tweet or news clip onto a TV / phone / billboard in a shot
fake 3D tilt of a document or newspaper cut-out in an explainer
perspective-angled picture-in-picture card in a news reel
trailer-style slanted panels
avoid: moving shots without tracking data: the pinned plane slides
extreme pins: texture smears and edges alias
cards.scripting: Points are [x, y] fractions of the frame (0..1, may go outside for overshoot). Uncovered area is transparent (black if nothing below). For screen replacement put the insert on V2 above the plate and set the four corners to the screen corners measured as fractions of 1920x1080.

verified.note: The clip is distorted into a tilted quadrilateral on black with corners at the demo fractions (UL 0.12,0.08 to LR 0.86,0.82).

cards.name: Crop
cards.summary: Trims the clip from the left, top, right and bottom by a percentage, optionally scaling the result up (Zoom) and feathering the cropped edge.
use_for: cinematic letterbox bars (Top/Bottom about 12.8 for 2.39:1 on 16:9)
split-screen / side-by-side comparisons of two leaders or two statements
remove burned-in logos or black edges from archive footage
animated reveal wipe of a graphic or quote card
avoid: Zoom on low-res footage: it upscales and softens
letterboxing with Crop on a vertical reel export: bars eat precious frame
rounded-corner PiP cards: use Rounded Crop (feather + roundness) instead

params.name: Zoom
params.does: scale the remaining area to fill the frame

params.name: Edge Feather
params.does: soft edge on the crop border, pixels
params.typical: 0 for hard bars, 20-60 for soft boxes

cards.equivalent: rectangle layer mask (AE has no Crop effect)
cards.scripting: Left/Top/Right/Bottom are 0..100 percent of the clip, measured from each edge. Cropped area is transparent, so lower tracks show through. Edge Feather is in pixels. For split screens crop each clip then move it with Motion Position.

verified.note: The frame is cropped about 12% left/right and 10% top/bottom to black with a soft feathered edge, giving a soft-edged inset box.

cards.name: Video Limiter
cards.summary: Limits luma and chroma to a chosen level so the output stays broadcast-safe, optionally compressing the top range before clipping and flagging out-of-gamut pixels.
use_for: final legal-levels pass on an adjustment layer before TV / news channel delivery
tame super-white highlights from phone and drone footage
avoid QC rejection on broadcast documentaries
avoid: placing it before Lumetri: grading after it can push levels out again; keep it last
stacking it with Broadcast Colors: double limiting, pick one (Video Limiter is the modern route)
low Clip Level on social-only content: needlessly dulls highlights

params.name: Compression before clipping
params.does: soft-knee range below the clip level (dropdown 0..4)

params.name: Gamut Warning Color
params.does: colour used to mark illegal pixels when the (unnamed, unaddressable) Gamut Warning checkbox is on; default is magenta #F00ADC
params.typical: #F00ADC default, or any colour absent from the footage

cards.equivalent: Video Limiter (AE has the same effect, ADBE DigitalVideoLimiter)
cards.scripting: Both dropdowns are 0-based and their labels are not verified: Compression before clipping is believed to be None/3%/5%/10%/20% (0 = None, default); Clip Level is a 4-step list of output levels with index 1 as default (believed the 100% legal level). The Gamut Warning checkbox is harvested with an empty name and cannot be addressed by name. In AE all four properties are non-animatable, so set static values only. Effect on normal footage is subtle; the demo uses the lowest Clip Level and the strongest compression so highlights visibly flatten. Apply to a top-track adjustment layer and keep it last in the chain.

verified.note: Looks identical to the reference; pixels show only highlights pulled down (max 255 to 244, 7% of pixels changed, mean diff 1.2) and the demo is already at the strongest options (Clip Level 0, Compression 4) while the gamut-warning checkbox has an empty name and cannot be set.

cards.name: Directional Blur (Legacy)
cards.summary: Blurs the image along one direction to suggest fast motion. Superseded by the newer Directional Blur effect.
use_for: maintaining older projects that already use it (same engine as AE's Directional Blur)
speed streak on a whip-pan cut or a sliding photo/title when the exact legacy look must match an old edit
avoid: new projects: use the GPU Directional Blur replacement
large Blur Length on faces: they become unrecognisable
cards.scripting: Apply the new GPU 'Directional Blur' by name instead; its properties are different (Angle, Amount, Chromatic Aberration, Edge Behavior), not Direction/Blur Length. If this legacy one is used: Direction is degrees (90 = horizontal streak, 0 = vertical), Blur Length 0..1000 (useful 0-100). Folder believed to be Obsolete in Premiere 2026, matching Gaussian Blur (Legacy).

verified.note: Frame was rendered despite the obsolete status and shows a strong horizontal motion smear (Direction 90, length 40) that wipes out faces and stripes.

cards.name: Drop Shadow
cards.summary: Adds a coloured, offset, optionally soft shadow behind the clip's alpha edges. Only shows where the clip has transparency or is scaled down.
use_for: lift a scaled-down picture-in-picture or screenshot card off the background in explainers
separate a PNG cut-out of a leader or logo from busy B-roll
readability shadow under text/graphics clips in news reels
avoid: full-frame opaque footage: the shadow is completely hidden behind the clip
hard (Softness 0) black shadows with large Distance look dated

params.name: Direction
params.does: direction the shadow falls, degrees (135 = down-right)

cards.scripting: Opacity is raw 0..255 (not percent; 127.5 = 50%). Visible only around transparent edges: scale the clip down (Motion Scale) or use alpha media first. The demo uses Shadow Only with a bright colour because on a full-frame clip the normal shadow cannot be seen; that output replaces the picture, so it is a diagnostic only, never a look. 'Long Shadow' is a different, newer effect (long flat-design shadow).

verified.note: With Shadow Only on, the full-frame clip is replaced by its soft yellow shadow offset down-right, leaving a black band along the top and left edges, so colour, offset and softness all read.

cards.name: Echo
cards.summary: Composites copies of the clip from earlier (or later) frames on top of the current frame, creating motion trails and ghosting.
use_for: dream / flashback ghost trails in a documentary reconstruction
music-reel trails on dancing, hand gestures or crowd motion
unsettling ghosting on a trailer tension beat
time-passing ghost crowd on locked-off city footage
avoid: talking heads: double faces look like a mistake
Add operator with many echoes: the frame blows out to white

params.name: Echo Time (seconds)
params.does: time offset between echoes; negative = earlier frames (trails)

params.name: Starting Intensity
params.does: opacity of the first frame in the chain, 0..1

params.name: Decay
params.does: how fast each later echo fades (meaningful 0..1)

cards.scripting: Echo works on the clip's source frames: Motion/Transform animation and effects applied before it are not echoed, so nest the clip (or animated graphic) first. Only visible where there is motion (the demo uses a 0.15 s spacing because the test clip moves slowly). Echo Time is seconds (one frame = 0.04 at 25 fps). Decay harvested range 0..100 but values above 1 make no sense; keep 0..1. 'Echo Glow' is an unrelated new glow effect.

verified.note: Ghosted copies of the moving figures trail across the frame and the Screen operator brightens the whole image, a clear motion-trail look.

cards.name: Edge Feather
cards.summary: Feathers all four edges of the clip into transparency, giving a soft rectangular vignette-like border.
use_for: soften the edges of a picture-in-picture or archive photo over a background
dreamy faded border for flashback / memory sequences
blend stacked photo layers in a documentary collage
avoid: as a vignette on full-frame clips with nothing below: reads as a cheap black border; use Vignette or Lumetri's vignette
when rounded corners are wanted: use Rounded Crop instead (it also has Feather)
cards.equivalent: Mask Feather on a rectangle mask
cards.scripting: Amount 0..100 (default 4). Feathered edges are transparent, so lower tracks show through; over nothing they fade to black.

verified.note: All four edges fade into dark transparency in a soft rectangular border while the centre stays untouched.

cards.name: Fast Blur
cards.summary: Quick box-style blur of the clip, horizontally, vertically or both. Used by the built-in 'Fast Blur In/Out' presets.
use_for: blur a duplicate background layer behind a vertical clip in a 9:16 reel
blur-in / blur-out title and scene openings
soften a busy B-roll plate behind explainer text
obscure faces, number plates or sensitive documents (with a mask)
avoid: small blur values on footage: looks like a focus mistake
Repeat Edge Pixels off on full-frame: dark halo creeps in from the edges

params.name: Repeat Edge Pixels
params.does: keeps edges from fading to black

cards.equivalent: Fast Box Blur (AE; AE's Fast Blur (Legacy) is this same engine)
cards.scripting: Blurriness range 0..30000, useful 0-200. Blur Dimensions is a 0-based dropdown (labels in enum_labels). Not marked Legacy in Premiere 2026. The new GPU 'Gaussian Blur' is a different effect with different property names (Amount, Angle, Thickness, Chromatic Aberration, Edge Behavior); for the old Blurriness-style Gaussian use 'Gaussian Blur (Legacy)'.

verified.note: The whole image is evenly defocused in both directions (faces and stripes unreadable) with clean, non-darkened edges.
